This template is intended to replace Wookieepedia's traditional "Appearances" lists.

==Usage==
*To add multiple columns to a section, add <code><nowiki>{{!}}</nowiki></code> on a line by itself where you want the column break to be.
*For sources with an official "Dramatis personae," use {{para|dramatis personae}} and {{para|other characters}} instead of {{para|characters}}. You may not use {{para|dramatis personae}} or {{para|other characters}} if you are already using {{para|characters}}.

*'''All fields now have canon-legends functionality. For sources that exist in both Legends and Canon, use the parameters "{{para||l-fieldname}}" and "{{para||c-fieldname}}" to separate the appearances from the two continuities.'''
